Name: SentientValley
Author: opvl
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Sentient Valley[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Dynamic AI Dialogue & NPC Agency[/i][/size]

[b]Transform Pelican Town into a living world where NPCs remember, feel, and act.[/b][/center]

[line]

[size=4][color=red][b]⚠️ CRITICAL ALPHA WARNING - READ FIRST[/b][/color][/size]
[b]This mod is a Work In Progress (WIP).[/b]
[list]
[*]It is highly experimental and [b]may cause issues with your existing save files[/b]. We strongly recommend backing up your saves or starting a new game for testing.
[*]We accept [b]NO RESPONSIBILITY[/b] for corrupted saves, adverse game interactions, or unexpected AI behavior.
[*]By installing this mod, you agree that you are running it entirely at your own risk.
[/list]

[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]

Sentient Valley replaces scripted dialogue with infinite, context-aware conversations powered by local AI.

[list]
[*][b]🧠 True Memory System[/b]
NPCs have Short-Term memory (conversation context) and Long-Term memory (The "Dreaming" System). If you tell Shane you like chickens, he will remember it next week.[*][b]🌍 Deep World Awareness[/b]
NPCs know the [b]Time, Weather, Season[/b], and [b]Community Center progress[/b]. They are aware of their relationships (dating/family) and current location.[*][b]🎭 Agency & Emotion[/b]
NPCs display emotional emotes (Happy/Angry/Sad) based on tone. They will physically look at you when speaking, or turn away if dismissive.[*][b]🚀 Action-Based Events[/b]
If a conversation leads to a location change (e.g., "Let's go to the beach"), the NPC will warp there to continue the interaction.[*][b]🔒 Private & Free[/b]
Runs locally on your PC via [b]LM Studio[/b]. No OpenAI API keys, no monthly fees, and your chats never leave your machine.[/list]

[line]

[size=5][b]🔮 Roadmap & Future Development[/b][/size]

We are actively working on the following features:
[list]
[*][b]Vanilla Relationship Integration:[/b] Your words will affect the game's heart system. Cruelty will damage relationships, while romance (like poetry on the beach) will make them fall in love.
[*][b]Full Movement Support:[/b] NPCs will physically walk to locations rather than teleporting.
[*][b]Gossip System:[/b] NPCs will share information with each other based on their relationships.
[*][b]Quest Integration:[/b] AI awareness of vanilla quests.
[*][b]Custom Sidequests:[/b] Dynamic quests generated by the AI.
[*][b]In-Game Chat Support:[/b] Native chat integration for easier typing.
[*][b]Config File Support:[/b] Easier user settings.
[*][b]Interactive GUI Wizard:[/b] To fine-tune context length, temperature, and system prompts easily.
[*][b]Cloud/API Support:[/b] Official support for ChatGPT/Cloud providers.
[*][b]Custom LLM Support:[/b] (Already technically supported by pointing the mod to any compatible local web address).
[/list]

[line]

[size=5][b]📥 Installation Guide[/b][/size]

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI (Latest Version)
[*]A PC capable of running Local LLMs (8GB+ RAM, NVIDIA GPU strongly recommended).
[/list]

[b]Step 1: The Mod[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and unzip [b]Sentient Valley[/b] into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.
[/list]

[b]Step 2: The AI Server (LM Studio)[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install [url=https://lmstudio.ai/]LM Studio[/url].
[*]Search for and download a conversation model (Recommendation: [font=Courier New]lumimaid-v0.2-8b-iq-imatrix[/font]).
[*]Search for and download a summarization model (Recommendation: [font=Courier New]phi-4-mini-instruct[/font]).
[*]Navigate to the [b]Local Server[/b] tab (Double arrow icon) in LM Studio.
[*]Load [b]BOTH[/b] models (See configuration below).
[*]Start the Server on Port [b]1234[/b].
[/list]

[b]Step 3: Play[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley via SMAPI.
[*]Click an NPC to talk. (First response may take a moment to "wake up" the AI).
[*]To reply, type in the SMAPI console: [code]reply I prefer goats over chickens, Shane.[/code]
[/list]

[line]

[size=5][b]⚙️ Recommended Model Config (Dual-Model)[/b][/size]

[i]For the best balance of roleplay quality and memory speed.
[b]Note:[/b] This setup leaves ~1GB of FREE VRAM remaining after models are loaded to actually run the game.[/i]

[b]1. Chat Model (The Persona)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Model:[/b] [font=Courier New]lumimaid-v0.2-8b-iq-imatrix[/font]
[*][b]Context:[/b] 1024
[*][b]GPU Offload:[/b] Max (Full)
[/list]

[b]2. Memory Model (The Background Summarizer)[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Model:[/b] [font=Courier New]phi-4-mini-instruct[/font]
[*][b]Context:[/b] 4096 (Required for reading logs)
[*][b]GPU Offload:[/b] Partial (Set to ~12/32 layers to save VRAM for the game).
[/list]
